verdict: V2 fixes the V1 comparator gap: exact ordered parent/point rosters, complete expected point reconstruction, and FD contents are now checked. Fixed-mass cut semantics remain correct. One source-drift guard is missing at the post-child comparison boundary: launch.py rechecks the general contract but does not recheck the caller-reviewed compare.py pin before importing and running that comparator. This should be closed before an actual run is treated as review-bound.

validated_changes.roster: check_roster_and_points independently requires dynamic (0,0..2),...(7,0..2),(0,0..2) and fixed-B (1,0..2), with exact order and integer indices. Both phases reject duplicate, missing, swapped, wrong-parent, coherently rehashed wrong-point, and swapped-point-content fixtures.
validated_changes.saved_points: expected_points reads the pinned layout and exact NPZ field roster, reconstructs both full source points and the declared third perturbation, then compares complete point layout/value objects and digests on every call. FD entries require the declared variable order, coordinate0, exact step, negative/positive complete point, output scalar match, and matching difference arithmetic.
validated_changes.fixed_cut: All eight original .125 masses remain protected; target remains population_cut_v1 with no parent mass in logp. Per-parent conditional normalization remains explicitly unverified; no downstream evidence reweight is proposed.
validated_changes.source_parity: Frozen evidence says child.py, evaluator.py, entry.py, launch.py and invented_worker.py are byte-identical to V1. V1 is preserved unchanged. The V2 comparator and contract are separately source-pinned.

independent_tiny_reproduction.scope: Copied V2 controller/child/evaluator/entry/comparator/test files and contract to fresh /tmp; ran all fixture tests using calibration Python with one thread, nice15, timeout30. No actual graph import/build/compile/evaluation.
independent_tiny_reproduction.outcome: 43 tests passed. Includes ordered-roster and complete-point negative cases, evaluator/source/cleanup fixtures, and exact point reconstruction. Dynamic/fixed phases remain invented fixture data only.
independent_tiny_reproduction.source_drift_probe: In the temporary copy, created a frozen review record pinning the original compare.py, then edited compare.py. common.admission correctly rejected that drift when called. common.read_contract accepted the changed compare.py because it is not in contract['pins']; this mirrors launch.py's post-child path, which calls read_contract() then imports compare without re-running packet-pin admission. The source gate catches drift before child launch, but the comparator is loaded after the worker, so a change during the bounded worker phase is a TOCTOU gap. This is not an actual exploit test and no source file in the packet was changed.

material_gap_and_fix.finding: The launch-time/entry admission checks the reviewed packet pins. After run_child returns, launch.py calls read_contract(), whose contract pins do not include compare.py, then imports compare.py. Consequently, a compare.py edit after entry admission but before comparison is not rejected by the post-child check. The exact V2 roster/point protections may then be bypassed by a changed comparator while the controller emits success.
material_gap_and_fix.required_guard: Retain review packet pins in launch state and rehash compare.py (and ideally all packet sources that will be imported/executed) immediately before comparator import; verify the imported module's __file__ and bytes. Alternatively import and retain the reviewed comparator before launching the worker. Add a negative fixture that changes compare.py after a successful child fixture but before comparison and requires no controller-success receipt.
material_gap_and_fix.severity: Close before actual run. This is a narrow source drift/time-of-check gap; the packet explicitly excludes hostile same-user coherent filesystem rewrites, but accidental concurrent source editing is not prevented at this final comparator boundary.

nonclaims: No actual graph or model code was imported or executed.
No dynamic exposure kernel behavior, parent0 baseline parity, fixed-B numerical anchor, resource feasibility, conditional normalization, posterior, prediction, or calibration result was tested.
The comparator fixes structural evidence consistency only; it does not authenticate numerical truth independently of the owned process and caller-retained receipts.
